title: Stand a parcel on the pallet mark the way its THIS SIDE UP arrows point
instruction: Put the parcel on the green pallet mark.
context: Warehouse and parcel-depot handlers are told where a package goes, not which way up: the package says that itself, with ISO 780 "this way up" arrows, and a handler who ignores them can spill or crush the contents. The parcel lies on its side, so it must be stood up a quarter turn, and turned the way the arrows say; the instruction deliberately leaves that to the marks. Done by: warehouse pickers, packers and loaders.
setup: Left and right are the robot's. Positions are in metres from the midpoint between the two arm bases: x forward, y to the robot's left; heights are above the table top. Parcel: a closed brown corrugated-cardboard box, 7 x 7 x 14 cm, 300 g (contents packed tight, evenly spread). On each of its four long sides a white paper label (5.6 cm across, 11 cm along the box, centred) printed with one bold black arrow 9 cm long (shaft 1.8 cm wide, head 4.6 cm wide and 3.5 cm long) pointing along the box to one end, its tip 2.5 cm short of that end; that end's square face is covered by a red paper panel. The parcel lies on one long side, its length along y, centred at (0.28, 0.16), its arrows and red end toward the right (the red end at y = 0.09). Green pallet mark: a 12 x 12 cm square of green floor-marking tape (about 2 mm) on the table, sides along x and y, centred at (0.30, -0.04). Nothing else is on the table. Both arms start in their ready pose, grippers open.
scoring: 0 if the parcel goes off the table at any time (its centre 5 cm below the table top). Otherwise, at the end, with the parcel let go (no gripper closed on it, every gripper at least 2 cm from it) and still (under 2 cm/s): 1.0 if it stands on the mark the right way up: its centre, seen from above, within 3 cm of the mark's centre, its bottom resting on the tape (within 1 cm), and its arrows' direction within 15 degrees of straight up (red end on top); 0.5 if it rests on the mark (centre within 3 cm, lowest point within 1 cm of the tape) any other way: upside down, lying, or leaning more than 15 degrees; else 0.25 if at some point it was lifted (its lowest point 3 cm or more above the table) or stood upright either way up anywhere; else 0. The trial ends with 1.0 once that holds for 1 s. Doing nothing scores 0.
reset_notes: Lay the parcel back at its marked position on its side, red end toward the right arm; which long side it lies on doesn't matter (all four carry the same arrow). Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: Rigid bodies, 240 Hz physics, 20 Hz control. The parcel is one rigid box with sharp edges and an even mass; a real carton flexes a little in the grip. Its labels, arrows and red panel are visual only. Friction 0.9 static, 0.8 dynamic. The tape is a fixed 2 mm slab. Contents, crushing and spills are not simulated: the score judges orientation, not damage.
